## Changed
On Automatic, Tiles downloads the llama.cpp build for the GPU by itself when it isn't on the computer, also after a reinstall https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/302
## Fixed
On a Mac the traffic lights no longer sit over dialogs, and the window no longer bounces when scrolled past its edge https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles-ui/pull/9
Back and forward are dimmed when there's no history https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles-ui/pull/9
The account menu is as wide as its content on a Mac https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles-ui/pull/7
The menu bar's info tooltips look like the app's https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles-ui/pull/8

### Added

- The Tiles desktop app for macOS and Linux: the chat window, with the menu bar on a Mac and a tray on Linux. `tiles ui` opens it, or the web UI in the browser when there's no app or display [#293](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/293)
- A web UI the daemon serves at `http://127.0.0.1:1730`, to chat, download and pick models, and switch the llama.cpp engine [#285](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/285)
- Link your devices and sync chats between them. A linked device can be dialed by its nickname as well as its DID [#275](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/275) [#290](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/290)
- Sign in with an ATmosphere account. Sign-in shows its progress and gives up after five minutes [#276](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/276)
- Old chats can be continued, also after Tiles restarts [#294](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/294)
- Tiles finds the GPU and downloads the llama.cpp build for it the first time a model runs. `tiles run` asks once before downloading [#289](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/289) [#291](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/291) [#292](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/292)
- Model downloads resume after a pause or a crash, and each file's SHA-256 is checked [#281](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/281)
- Pick the model chats use, and delete downloaded models, including the one in use after unloading it [#285](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/285) [#294](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/294)
- Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B and 31B, next to the default Gemma 4 12B [#281](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/281)
- Keep the Mac awake, also with the lid closed [#227](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/227) [#284](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/284)
- `tiles service install` starts the daemon at login [#200](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/200)
- `install.sh --headless` installs only the daemon, without the app and the web UI, for servers [#293](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/293)
- Tilekit, the daemon's HTTP API for accounts, sessions, the agent, the inference server, models and engines [#196](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/196)

### Changed

- Linux ships one tarball with the CPU build of llama.cpp, instead of one per GPU backend [#292](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/292)
- Every platform runs the same upstream llama.cpp release. `load_mode` replaces `no_mmap` in `config.toml` [#286](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/286)
- The menu bar is part of the desktop app, and the separate menu bar app is gone [#293](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/293)
- Routes that change something are POST and need a JSON content type, so websites can't call the daemon through the browser [#277](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/277)

### Removed

- The gpt-oss and Qwen Modelfiles [#281](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/281)

### Fixed

- Starting the inference server waits until it's ready, and stopping it waits until it has exited, so no server is left behind [#272](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/272)
- Chats are saved with the right model and account, and a failed save leaves no empty session [#271](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/271) [#274](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/274)

### Security

- Updated rustls-webpki, webpki-roots and certifi for the eMudhra CA compromise, plus rustls and h2 advisories [#279](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/279)

### Added

- `--mtp` flag for `tiles run` to enable/disable MTP speculative decoding (persists to `config.toml` like the other llama flags).

- Model-load warnings from the inference server (e.g. MTP requested but no MTP head GGUF found) are now surfaced in the CLI as yellow `WARNING:` lines before the input prompt.

### Changed

- MTP speculative decoding is now opt-in: it no longer auto-enables when an MTP head GGUF is detected next to the model. Enable it with `mtp = true` under `[llama]` in `config.toml` or per-run with `tiles run --mtp`.

### Fixed

- Chances of installing multiple version of Tiles during `tiles update` [#194](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/194)

## What's Changed

### Added
- Added Vulkan support for llama.cpp, enabling GPU acceleration beyond NVIDIA across vendors on Linux. [#189](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/189)

### Fixed

- MTP was disabled due to a hardcoded symlink. [#187](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/187)

- (Linux) Tool calls were returning 422 errors due to incorrect types introduced by an openresponses-types version bump. [#188](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/188)

- OAuth callbacks sometimes failed during ATproto login because the child process used to open the browser did not resolve immediately. [#190](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/190)

@bruhfr29 FTW

## What's Changed
* remote-inference v0 by @madclaws in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/182
* Decouple Pi agent from repl by @madclaws in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/183
* LLama-server refactors by @PrimalPimmy in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/181
* chore: security patch upgrades by @madclaws in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/184
* Gemma 4 12b as default model along with auto enabling MTP if the model supports it by @PrimalPimmy in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/185
* Release 0.14.7 by @PrimalPimmy in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/186


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/compare/0.4.16...0.4.17

### Added

- Peer-to-peer remote inference.
- Inference now runs through llama-server across platforms.

### Added

- Added `tiles uninstall` command to uninstall tiles from the system [#173](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/173)
  - By default it will keep the user data folder and config.toml. If pass `--all` will do a complete cleanup.

- Added ATproto lexicon support for the shared sessions. The lexicon for that can be found [here](https://lexicon.garden/lexicon/did:plc:mqmcsjuerbjhu65mpmvkcuw2/run.tiles.chat.sessionSnapshot) [#175](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/175)

### Fixed
- Optimizations in ToolCalling by adding timeouts and removing recursive syscalls + preventing 422 errors in /v1/responses api [#174](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/174).
- Set Pi's compaction setting to false by default to prevent it interfering with prompt/response cycle [#174](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/174).

### Added

- Implemented Tiles plugin system [#171](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/171).

  - `tiles plugin install <url / filesystem-path>`, `tiles plugin uninstall <plugin-name>`, `tiles plugin list` (for installed plugins).
    - Plugins should be a `.zip` or `.tar.gz` file either hosted or available in local filesystem.
    ```markdown

      ## Plugin folder structure

      plugin_name
        - extensions
          - extension_1
            - ...
          - extension_2
            - ...
        - skills
          - skill_1
            - SKILLS.md
      ```
    - Added skills support via plugins
      - In repl use `/skills` for list of skills and `$<skill-name>` to use the skill directly. Tiles can use available skills as needed too.

### Changed

- Upgraded project dependencies [#168](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/168), [#170](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/170).

### Added
- Added `tiles run` flags for llama.cpp tuning: `--context-length`, `--gpu-layers`, `--offload-kqv`, and `--batch-size` [#160](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/160).
- Added a daemon `/config` endpoint so the Python inference backend can read Rust-owned Tiles config [#160](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/160).

### Changed
- Persist llama.cpp settings under `[llama]` in `config.toml` instead of using `TILES_LLAMA_CPP_*` environment variables [#160](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/160).
- Reload the Linux llama.cpp runner when llama configuration changes, even if the selected model path stays the same [#160](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/160).
- Reworked link command UX around `tiles link create`, `tiles link add`, `tiles link list-peers`, and `tiles link revoke`, with support for both offline link codes and UCAN tokens [#163](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/163).
- Renamed inference system controls  from `tiles inference` to `tiles server` with `start`, `stop`, and `daemon` subcommands [#163](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/163).
- Switched Harmony handling to `tiles-harmony` across active server manifests [#162](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/162).

### Fixed
- Improved gpt-oss tool call handling by normalizing malformed tool names, passing tool metadata into Harmony conversation replay, and detecting tool calls emitted through the analysis channel [#162](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/162).
- Fixed tool-call streaming state handling so final answers and function-call arguments are emitted more reliably [#162](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/162).
- Improved dev Modelfile handling so `cargo run -- run modelfiles/gpt-oss-gguf` no longer depends on a pre-existing copied default Modelfile [#160](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/160).

## What's Changed
### Added
- Added full support for Linux. Model Inference(llama.cpp), keychain management, Installer etc by @PrimalPimmy [#138](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/138).

- Added UCAN based capability tokens for authorization in p2p syncing, thus replacing the need for synchronous peer linking [#154](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/154)
    - Added two new sub commands under `tiles link`. `tiles link create-token <DID>`, which creates a UCAN token for the DID. `tiles link add-token <token>`, adds a given UCAN token to local DB for further use in in syncing.

### Changed
- Changed `tiles server` command to `tiles inference` with a newly added sub-command `run-background` which takes a boolean value. If true, closing the Tiles repl won't close the inference [#156](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/156), [#157](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/157).
- Added extra metadata regarding tool and the arguments used in a tool-call to the session records, thus can be seen in Tiles sessions hosted in ATproto PDS [#155](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/155).

### Added
- New repl command `/reasoning` to switch reasoning effort on the fly [#150](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/150), [#153](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/153).
  - eg: `/reasoning low` - sets effort to low. Other options are medium, high

### Fixed

### Changed
- Using the tool_call name model gives, instead of figuring out from the tool_call arguments [#151](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/151).

## What's Changed

### Fixed
- Fixed config and user directory empty issue during initial db connection in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/114
- Fixed  model download not resuming for partial downloads in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/115

## What's Changed

### Added
- Added P2P chat sync in [#109](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/109)
  - Commands for chat syncing
    - `tiles sync` - Starts listening for a sync request from the linked peers.
    - `tiles sync <DID>` - Initiates the syncing with the peer using the peer's linked DID (which one can get from `tiles link list-peers`).
- Added at rest encryption for local databases in [#110](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/110)

### Fixed
- Fixed the loading issue of qwen 3.5 series in [#111](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/111)

## What's Changed

### Added
- Added P2P device linking v1 in [#106](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/106).
  - Works both online and offline networks
  - Utility Commands for device linking
    - `tiles link enable` - creates the ticket and listens for any link requests
    - `tiles link enable <ticket>`- Device that need to join will run this command with the ticket from the sender. **NOTE**: The ticket sharing is out-of-band.
    - `tiles link list-peers` - Shows the info (DID, nickname etc) of the linked devices.
    - `tiles link disable <DID>` - Unlinks a linked device 

### Fixed
- Fixed the permission issues while trying to update Tiles using `tiles update` in [#104](https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/104). This was due to new binary location is in `/usr/` instead of `~/.local/`. Running the internal script with `sudo` fixed it.

 **NOTE**: daemon will auto-start when you run `tiles`.
- Added support for fully offline/portable installer in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/97

## What's Changed

### Tiles 0.4.0
* Implemented a portable Python runtime in the installer by @madclaws in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/75  
  * Tiles can now be installed without any system Python or other system dependencies.
* Bundled default Modelfiles and now read the system prompt directly from the Modelfile by @madclaws in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/76
  * Default Modelfiles are bundled directly with the Tiles installer.
* **feat:** Added support for gpt-oss-20b in interactive chat by @madclaws in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/79  
  * gpt-oss-20b is supported and used as the default model for non-memory chat.
* Added basic support for the Open Responses API (`/v1/responses`) and REST endpoints by @madclaws in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/82.
* Added token metrics for model responses in the REPL.
* Added the `-m` flag to `tiles run` to execute Tiles in memory mode. This is an experimental feature.

### Tilekit 0.2.0
* **feat:** Added the `optimize` subcommand for automatic SYSTEM prompt optimization using DSRs (#45) by @bxff in https://github.com/tilesprivacy/tiles/pull/61  
  * `tiles optimize <Modelfile>` updates the Modelfile’s system prompt using server based LLMs as optimizer models.
